responsibility: Implements trait-specific diagnostics emitted from inference, including reporting when an impl adds stricter obligations than its trait declaration and constructing detailed object-safety errors with labeled violation spans, suggestions, and type-specific fallback advice based on known impls.
same_name_distinction: This is the trait-system-specific reporting `mod.rs`, not the general inference one. Its functions build diagnostics for trait failures such as stricter-than-trait impl requirements and object-safety violations, whereas `error_reporting/infer/mod.rs` handles generic type/region inference reports and `errors/mod.rs` only supplies reusable diagnostic data structures.
